title: Process fixes: session minions through the gate, owner-words check, page holds on restart

message.text: Why the sheet broke: the voice session spawned minions straight into the main tree (chat-duplicate-messages, chat-autoscroll, chat-menu-merge, context-card-type, voice-tts), with no worktree and no gate. Why the page went white: the dev server restarts on any write under Server/, and agents write there on every merge. Two Sonnet minions are queued: session-gate (Servex moves every minion into a pool worktree; a landing checks the owner's words item by item in /framework/ai/2026-10-01/session-gate/) and page-holds (restart only when the server's own files change; the page holds and reconnects, in /framework/ai/2026-10-01/page-holds/).

Built both fixes: a minion a voice session spawns now goes into a pool worktree, never the main tree (Agents.spawn + Pool.take_sync, 4/4 tests pass), and a new Server/owner-check.mjs checks a landed task against the owner's own dictated words, item by item. Proved live against public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow — see owner-check.md there. Review running now (full, Opus — the diff touches Servex/ and adds new modules).

Landed: server.js now only restarts for a file it really loads (a tool-script edit like merge.mjs logs "no restart" and does nothing — proved live), and Socket.js shows a small "server restarting… reconnecting" strip instead of ever looking blank (headless-proved, page content never blanks, strip clears on reconnect). The 15:32 blank wasn't actually a Server/ restart — that supervisor wasn't even running at the time — it was a live edit landing directly on ext/drawer/rail.js in the main tree, which is the same incident your voice-session-minions note already names. The "catch-up reload" item needs a wire change in Server/plugins/SocketServer/ (outside this task's fence) — named as a follow-up, not done. Details and screenshots: /framework/ai/2026-10-01/page-holds/

Landed 3ab8b4ba. A minion a session spawns now always goes through a worktree — moved into a pool slot, or the spawn is refused outright, never a silent fallback to main (5/5 tests). A new Server/owner-check.mjs checks every landing against the owner's own dictated words, item by item; proved live on proposal-flow (8 items, 1 done/1 partly/6 missing) and on a no-words task. Full Opus review ran, 7 findings all fixed/answered. One loose end: the private worktree dir is still on disk (not a pool slot, harmless) — safe for a sweep.

Both fixes landed. Minions can no longer edit the live site: Servex moves any minion with no worktree into a pool slot before its first turn, and the voice session's brief now says to spawn a task-mastermind, never a minion (merge 3ab8b4ba; live after the next Servex restart, which is mine). Every landed task is now checked against the owner's own words, item by item, with a table in its folder and a card nag for a missed item (/framework/ai/2026-10-01/session-gate/). The dev server restarts only when a file it actually loads changes, and the page keeps its content through a restart with one small "reconnecting" strip (merge 6e4deaf8; your :80 server picks it up at its next restart) — the 15:32 blank was itself a main-tree live edit by a session minion, so fix 1 is the real cure (/framework/ai/2026-10-01/page-holds/). Left: the catch-up reload after a long gap needs a socket-protocol change (page-holds' follow-up). Cost: $25 across two Sonnet minions.
